source.subject: Sanitized Attainable Housing Fund III opportunity
source.sourceText: Sanitized Attainable Housing Fund III is a real estate investment fund targeting workforce and attainable multifamily housing in the Southeast and Texas. The Fund has a $450M target, and the minimum investment is $1M. The offering includes Class A and Class B investor interests. Class A has an 8% preferred return and quarterly cash distributions after asset stabilization; Class B participates in residual appreciation. The Fund term is 10 years with two optional one-year extensions. Target portfolio allocation is 70% existing attainable multifamily assets and 30% development or conversion programs. Page 6 states that $175M is committed and $120M has been deployed across 14 properties. Page 18 states that $168M has been contributed and $132M has been deployed across 16 properties. The strategy expects cost-segregation studies and accelerated depreciation where available, subject to each investor's tax circumstances. Target investors include pensions, endowments, and family offices. The manager charges a 1.5% management fee on commitments and 20% carried interest after the preferred return. An illustrative property model shows a 19% gross IRR and 2.0x equity multiple; this scenario is not actual fund performance, is not guaranteed, and is not stated as the Fund's expected return. The Fund seeks to complete fundraising by Q2 2027 and reports $275M remaining against the target. The sender is available for questions and can connect prospective investors with the portfolio operations team. Disclosed risks include: higher interest rates may increase financing costs and reduce asset values; new apartment supply and concessions may pressure rents and occupancy; execution depends on property-level operations and lease-up; development projects face construction-cost and schedule risk; results depend on third-party developers and operators; and REIT qualification, tax law, zoning, or other regulatory changes may affect outcomes. No Beaman Ventures proposed check, allocation, or commitment is stated.
